items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I think you remember the Head Cap? Uh, Andrew Morgan and the bank of them up there? ... They had Andrew Morgan, they had Cap, Homer Eugene, and I just remember, they had two men, about four or five, and they were recording or doing something.

ctx.x: Not even the one you sang on.

You can't remember. No. I know it was the blues and some other number that I sang on. But, uh, we had a lovely time there, you know, playing. Because we always, you know, putting our effort in it. But for me, I mean, I never did worry about if you were recording or doing anything. It's just my daddy taught us to do our thing. If you used to notice Cap, Cap didn't worry about anybody. He didn't worry about it. He just looked like he just took his own and he went on and blew his own. He didn't worry about who was…
What was that some long ago? Mmm...
